sub_agendas_items.title: Chair of the Board of Health Verbal Report
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Chair Kitts welcomed members of the Ottawa Board of Health back to session following the holiday break. Chair Kitts reflected on the significance of Black History Month and noted the significant health and social disparities that still exist due to anti-Black racism and how the Board and Ottawa Public Health continue commit to integration of equity into the fabric of everything we do. 
Chair Kitts also provided a recap of the Rural Ontario Municipal Association Conference and discussed funding for routine childhood vaccinations. 
The discussion on this item lasted approximately 4 minutes. The report was then received by the Board. The attached memo includes the Chair’s Verbal Update.

motions.motion_text: That the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit receive this verbal report for information.

sub_agendas_items.title: Medical Officer of Health Verbal Report
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Dr. Etches discussed working with Indigenous partners to address evolving community needs in addition to acknowledging the efforts from Ottawa Public Health’s Indigenous Rights and Reconciliation team. She then provided updates on Children and Youth Immunization Coverage, COVID-19 and Respiratory Illness, Group A Streptococcus, Mental Health and Substance-use Health, and Black History Month.
Discussions on this item lasted approximately 25 minutes. The report was then received by the Board. The attached memo includes the Medical Officer of Health’s Verbal Update.

motions.motion_text: That the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit receive this verbal report for information.

sub_agendas_items.title: Verbal Report on the Board of Health Education Session Regarding Voluntary Mergers
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Chair Kitts discussed the Government of Ontario’s announcement of one-time funding for local public health agencies to explore opportunities for voluntary mergers. She noted that while this initiative is primarily aimed at boards in smaller communities and rural regions, the goal of the province is to make better use of existing assets and reinvest any savings from mergers back into improving programs to better serve people. The Chair brought forward merger-related options assessed by OPH staff and encouraged discussion.
The discussion on this item lasted approximately 15 minutes. The report was then carried by the Board. The attached memo includes the Verbal Update.

sub_agendas_items.title: Verbal Report - Education Session Voluntary Mergers
Indigenous Health, Rights and Reconciliation: Annual Update

attachments.attachment_title: 04_Doc 3_Indigenous Youth Talking Circle_Sharing Thoughts on Reconciliation.pdf

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
The Board then received an Indigenous Health, Rights, and Reconciliation annual update recognizing Ottawa Public Health’s continuing efforts to become a culturally safe and humble organization, as outlined in the OHP Reconcili-ACTION Plan. 
The Board received presentations from representatives from the Ottawa Aboriginal Coalition, Minwaashin Lodge, Akausivik Inuit Family Health Team, Innuqatigiit Centre and the Canadian Centre on Substance Use and Addiction. 
Discussion of this item lasted approximately 45 minutes.

motions.motion_text: THAT the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit receive, for information, this update on Ottawa Public Health’s continuing efforts to become a culturally safe and humble organization, as outlined in the OPH Reconcili-ACTION Plan.

sub_agendas_items.title: Attendance at the Association of Local Public Health Agencies’ (alPHa) Winter Symposium

motions.motion_text: THAT the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit approve the participation of Chair Kitts, Vice-Chair DeGiovanni and Member Bauer at the Association of Local Public Health Agencies’ (alPHa) Winter Symposium, to be held February 16, 2024.

BE IT RESOLVED THAT the Confirmation of the Chair and Vice-Chair for 2024, the Chair of the Board of Health Verbal Report, the Medical Officer of Health Verbal Report, the Verbal Report on the Education Session Regarding Voluntary Mergers and the reports titled: Indigenous Health, Rights and Reconciliation: Annual Update and Attendance at the Association of Local Public Health Agencies’ (alPHa) Winter Symposium, be received and adopted.
